info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Get P2m By Param1-spec
info.description: The Settlement Account Retrieval API allows users to fetch detailed information about a specific settlement account based on a unique parameter. This endpoint is primarily used by financial institutions or applications needing to track and manage settlement account data efficiently. By providing the necessary parameter, consumers can retrieve relevant details swiftly, enabling them to support data-driven decision-making and streamline their operations. Use cases include monitoring account statuses, verifying transactional records, and supporting regulatory compliance efforts.

get.summary: Retrieve a specific settlement account by its ID.
get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch detailed information about a settlement account identified by its unique account ID. Use this operation to obtain the account's current status, balance, and associated details.

requestBody.description: This request body retrieves the details of the settlement account identified by 'ACC-200045'. The expected input should conform to the defined schema to ensure all necessary parameters are included for a successful retrieval.

200.description: Successfully retrieved the settlement account details.

GetP2mByParam1Request.title: Settlement Account Request Body
GetP2mByParam1Request.description: This schema represents the request body format for operations related to settlement accounts.

GetP2mByParam1Response_200.title: Settlement Account Response

settlementAccountId.description: The unique identifier of the settlement account.

merchantId.description: The unique identifier of the merchant associated with the settlement account.

isDefault.description: Indicates whether this settlement account is the default account.

verificationStatus.description: The status of verification of the settlement account.

status.description: The current status of the settlement account.

ScheduleDetails.description: The schedule information related to the settlement account.
